    //==
    // # Polygon-versus-plane classification and splitting
    //
    // The foundational CSG primitives on the types in `solids.types.plato`:
    // the supporting plane of a convex polygon, the four-way polygon/plane
    // classification, and Sutherland-Hodgman clipping of a convex polygon to a
    // half-space and splitting by a plane.
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sutherland%E2%80%93Hodgman_algorithm)
    //
    // Conventions:
    //   * Every polygon is CONVEX and planar with CCW-outward winding
    //     (`PolygonSoup3D`'s invariant); clipping a non-convex ring is not defined
    //     here.
    //   * The plane's FRONT is its positive half-space (`lines.types.plato`);
    //     clipping keeps the front, boundary inclusive.

    // The on-plane thickness for polygon/plane classification: a vertex within
    // this absolute distance of a plane counts as lying ON it. One shared knob
    // rather than a magic number in each body.
    CsgPlaneTolerance(_: Number): Number
        => 0.00000001;
